label: platform sweep
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city Testville, ZIP 99999, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.page: Solidus - Sample Store (home, product, cart, checkout pages)
findings.problem: No skip-to-content link and no landmarks I could perceive: every page starts with about 10 tab stops of header controls before any content, and I had to use Shift+Tab from the top to wrap to the end of the page to reach the main button (Add to cart, Checkout, Save and Continue).
Header has focusable controls with no name: an icon button, an unlabeled checkbox, and an unnamed link and icon links. I could not tell what they do (search, cart, account).
Hero product links all say only SHOP NOW, so I cannot tell which product a link opens; I had to guess that the first was the Water Bottle.

findings.page: Solidus Water Bottle / Shopping Cart / Checkout
findings.problem: After activating a link or button, the page reads as completely blank for the first moment and focus resets to the top of the page; I had to read again to find out what loaded. No announcement that the cart or step changed.
After Add to cart I landed in the cart with no confirmation message and focus was reset to the top, so I had to go backwards through the whole page to reach the Checkout button.

The Customer email heading shows no value, and the Country list (about 250 entries) and State list are very long selects; the State select had no preselected value and the form gave no hint that it was required. Pressing Down just picked Alabama.

Focus is reset to the top of the page after each Save and Continue, with no announcement of the new checkout step, so I had to tab backwards from the end again to reach the shipping options and the next button.

Payment form fields (name on card, card number, expiration, card code) and the Check option are shown only as labels in the text I perceive; I could not confirm they are focusable controls with proper names.

findings.page: Solidus - Sample Store (home, product, cart, checkout pages)
findings.problem: No skip-to-content link and no landmarks I could perceive: every page starts with about 10 tab stops of header controls before any content, and I had to use Shift+Tab from the top to wrap to the end of the page to reach the main button (Add to cart, Checkout, Save and Continue).
Header has focusable controls with no name: an icon button, an unlabeled checkbox, and an unnamed link and icon links. I could not tell what they do (search, cart, account).
Hero product links all say only SHOP NOW, so I cannot tell which product a link opens; I had to guess that the first was the Water Bottle.

findings.page: Solidus Water Bottle / Shopping Cart / Checkout
findings.problem: After activating a link or button, the page reads as completely blank for the first moment and focus resets to the top of the page; I had to read again to find out what loaded. No announcement that the cart or step changed.
After Add to cart I landed in the cart with no confirmation message and focus was reset to the top, so I had to go backwards through the whole page to reach the Checkout button.

The Customer email heading shows no value, and the Country list (about 250 entries) and State list are very long selects; the State select had no preselected value and the form gave no hint that it was required. Pressing Down just picked Alabama.

Focus is reset to the top of the page after each Save and Continue, with no announcement of the new checkout step, so I had to tab backwards from the end again to reach the shipping options and the next button.

Payment form fields (name on card, card number, expiration, card code) and the Check option are shown only as labels in the text I perceive; I could not confirm they are focusable controls with proper names.
